name: simplelogin-aio
description: SimpleLogin is an open-source email alias platform that lets you shield your real inbox behind forwarding aliases. All-In-One Unraid Edition `simplelogin-aio` packages the web UI, background jobs, inbound email handler, Postfix, PostgreSQL, and Redis into one Unraid-first container with persistent appdata paths. Quick Install (Beginners) 1. Install this template in Unraid. 2. Set [code]URL[/code], [code]EMAIL_DOMAIN[/code], [code]SUPPORT_EMAIL[/code], and [code]FLASK_SECRET[/code]. 3. Registration is disabled by default for safety. Temporarily set [code]DISABLE_REGISTRATION[/code] to [code]false[/code] only if you need web sign-up for first boot, then switch it back to [code]true[/code] and restart. 4. Choose an outbound relay mode if your ISP blocks outbound TCP 25. 5. Forward inbound TCP 25 from your router/firewall to the Unraid host if you want internet mail delivery. 6. Start the container, wait for first boot to finish, then add the required DNS records from the setup guide. Power Users (Advanced View) - Advanced View exposes the full official upstream self-hosting environment surface plus wrapper-specific relay and AIO controls. - Leave defaults in place for the easiest install. Only set overrides you actually need. - You can point the app at external PostgreSQL or Redis, customize alias domain behavior, enable SSO providers, tune anti-spam and analytics integrations, and provide custom asset/key files through the optional [code]/custom-assets[/code] mount. Important Notes - Current upstream packaging is [code]linux/amd64[/code] only. - This is still a real self-hosted mail stack. DNS, deliverability, router/firewall port forwarding, and sender reputation still matter. - For the simplest operation, keep the internal Postgres/Redis/Postfix defaults and only set the small required config set above.

paths.name: Appdata Directory
paths.description: Primary persistent directory for PostgreSQL, Redis, DKIM keys, uploads, generated JWT keys, and application state.

paths.name: PGP Keyring Directory
paths.description: Persistent directory for your GnuPG keyring and optional server-generated PGP signing keys.

paths.name: Custom Assets Directory
paths.description: Optional host path mounted at /custom-assets for advanced file-based settings such as custom words lists, OpenID keys, Paddle public keys, or imported PGP material.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port used by the SimpleLogin web UI.

ports.name: SMTP Inbound Port
ports.description: Inbound SMTP port. Forward TCP 25 from your router or firewall to the Unraid host if you want aliases to receive internet mail.

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: Canonical HTTPS URL for the dashboard, for example https://app.example.com. This does not need to be the same as your SMTP/MX hostname.

variables.name: Primary Email Domain
variables.description: Real public alias domain, for example example.com. Do not use a private-only tailnet domain here. First-account registration must use a separate existing mailbox, not this alias domain.

variables.name: Support Email
variables.description: Working mailbox used for system mail, for example support@example.com. Use an address that already exists.

variables.name: Flask Secret
variables.description: Long random app secret. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: SMTP Relay Mode
variables.description: Outbound mail mode. Choose one of the built-in dropdown values only: direct, brevo, protonmail, gmail, mailgun, or custom. Use a relay provider if your ISP blocks outbound TCP 25.

variables.name: Brevo Username
variables.description: Brevo SMTP username, usually your account email. Required when RELAY_MODE=brevo.

variables.name: Brevo Password
variables.description: Brevo SMTP key or password. Required when RELAY_MODE=brevo.

variables.name: Proton Mail SMTP Token
variables.description: Proton SMTP token. Required when RELAY_MODE=protonmail. The username stays SUPPORT_EMAIL.

variables.name: Gmail Username
variables.description: Full Gmail address used for relay auth. Required when RELAY_MODE=gmail.

variables.name: Gmail App Password
variables.description: 16-character Gmail app password. Required when RELAY_MODE=gmail.

variables.name: Mailgun Username
variables.description: Mailgun SMTP username, usually postmaster@yourdomain. Required when RELAY_MODE=mailgun.

variables.name: Mailgun Password
variables.description: Mailgun SMTP password. Required when RELAY_MODE=mailgun.

variables.name: Custom Relay Host
variables.description: Required when RELAY_MODE=custom. Example: [smtp.provider.com]:587

variables.name: Custom Relay Username
variables.description: SMTP username for your custom relay. Required when RELAY_MODE=custom.

variables.name: Custom Relay Password
variables.description: SMTP password for your custom relay. Required when RELAY_MODE=custom.

variables.name: External PostgreSQL DB_URI
variables.description: Leave blank for the bundled database. When set to an external host, the bundled PostgreSQL stays idle. Format: postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/dbname

variables.name: External Redis URL
variables.description: Leave blank for the bundled Redis. When set to an external host, the bundled Redis stays idle. Format: redis://:pass@host:6379/0

variables.name: Postfix Server Override
variables.description: Advanced escape hatch. Leave at 127.0.0.1 to keep the bundled Postfix path.

variables.name: Postfix Port Override
variables.description: Advanced escape hatch. Leave at 25 for the bundled Postfix path.

variables.name: DNS Nameservers
variables.description: Comma-separated resolvers used for lookups, for example 1.1.1.1,1.0.0.1.

variables.name: Custom Temp Directory
variables.description: Optional temp directory path inside the container or a mounted path.

variables.name: Words File Path
variables.description: Advanced path override for the words file used for random alias generation. Use /custom-assets if you mount your own file.

variables.name: Local File Uploads
variables.description: Leave true for local file storage inside /appdata.

variables.name: GnuPG Home
variables.description: GnuPG home directory path used for PGP features.

variables.name: Partner API Token Secret
variables.description: Optional partner token secret. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Blank uses FLASK_SECRET.

variables.name: Disable Registration
